rules.name: Stack of short fragments
rules.description: Three or more tiny sentences in sequence can simulate emphasis without adding precision.
rules.message: Several very short sentences appear in a row.
rules.suggestion: Combine them unless the abrupt rhythm is deliberate and genre-appropriate.

rules.name: Uniform paragraph sizing
rules.description: Paragraphs with nearly identical length can make attention feel mechanically distributed.
rules.message: Several paragraphs have nearly the same word count.
rules.suggestion: Review whether one idea deserves more space and another can be compressed.

rules.name: Uniform sentence rhythm
rules.description: Long passages with little sentence-length variation can sound mechanically even.
rules.message: Sentence lengths vary very little across the passage.
rules.suggestion: Read aloud and vary only where emphasis or clarity benefits.

rules.name: Repeated sentence openings
rules.description: Repeated opening words can reveal a template or an unedited list converted to prose.
rules.message: Multiple sentences begin with the same words.
rules.suggestion: Merge parallel sentences or vary the syntax where the repetition is accidental.

rules.name: Transition-heavy paragraph openings
rules.description: A connector at the start of most paragraphs can make the structure over-signposted.
rules.message: Many paragraphs begin with explicit transition phrases.
rules.suggestion: Remove connectors where the relationship is already clear from the content.
